label: Figure 10.1: Total cost, total variable cost and total fixed cost
alt: Graph of TFC, TVC and TC against output: TFC is a flat line at $200, TVC starts at the origin and rises slowly then steeply, and TC runs exactly $200 above TVC starting from $200.
caption: TFC is a horizontal line at $200. TVC starts at the origin and rises slowly at first, then more steeply as diminishing marginal returns set in. TC is the vertical sum of the two, so it starts at $200 and stays exactly $200 above TVC at every output (for example TVC is $224 and TC is $424 at 8 units).
